summary: Verification/hardening phase. Proves pcae runtime inspect (111C) is stable, read-only, backward-compatible with the Runtime Introspection architecture (111A/111B) and the Runtime Registry (110A-110F), performant, and incapable of introducing execution behavior. No source code changes -- a full re-read of both src/pcae/commands/runtime_inspect.py and src/pcae/core/runtime_introspection.py found no defect requiring a fix (unlike 110F's manifest-immutability finding); both files confirmed unchanged. CLI verified stable: all three output modes (default, --json, --verbose) reconfirmed functional and proven byte-identical across repeated invocations; a cross-mode consistency test confirms human/verbose/JSON output never disagree on the three load-bearing facts. JSON schema frozen as an explicit, tested stable observation contract: the eight top-level keys and every section's exact field set are now constants a future phase would have to deliberately update to change; populating the registry confirmed to change list contents only, never the key set. Read-only guarantees re-verified with sharper tooling than 111C used: no registry/runtime/plugin/metadata mutation, identity-checked (a PluginDescriptor fetched before/after a snapshot call confirmed to be the literal same object); 110F's manifest-immutability hardening reconfirmed to survive the full CLI snapshot path; no PermissionBroker.evaluate() call, confirmed via an AST-based call-site check across both files; no plugin loading/instantiation/invocation method exists on the command module, introspection module, or RuntimeRegistry itself; no command execution (subprocess import confirmed absent via AST); an adversarial manifest-smuggled-callable canary run through the actual _build_snapshot() to json.dumps() path end to end. Compatibility cross-checked against every phase named: pipeline stages against 110A's live doc text, capability classes against 110B's live doc text, 110C's service registry doc existence, 110D's GetPluginMetadata()/ListPlugins() API names, 110E/110F's RuntimeRegistry/PluginDescriptor/RegistrySnapshot still present, 111A's introspection domain names against live doc text, 111B's eight get_*() functions confirmed unmodified, 111C's CLI subparser/handler still registered, and 109C's INTEGRATION_REGISTRY reconfirmed still exactly four INT-NNN entries. Performance verified: --verbose completes well under a 2-second smoke threshold; no filesystem-scanning call, network call, or dynamic-plugin-discovery mechanism anywhere in either module; _build_snapshot()'s AST confirmed to contain zero explicit loop statements; ten repeated snapshot-assembly calls show no cross-invocation time accumulation. Security verified: no secret-shaped term in any output mode; neither module reads os.environ or calls os.getenv; the JSON registry section confirmed to never contain the live internal dict itself; every JSON value recursively confirmed non-callable; manifest field remains absent everywhere; 111C's import allowlist reconfirmed unchanged. Added docs/PHASE_111_RUNTIME_INSPECT_VERIFICATION.md. docs/ROADMAP.md evaluated and found to need no change. 55 new tests (tests/test_runtime_inspect_verification.py). Focused tests (693), governance/autonomy group (2166), and the release/lifecycle regression subset actually present (1429/1429, excluding the two known-slow phase85/phase87 integration files) all passed under -n auto; fast_green 4390/4390 (matches documented baseline).
